description: Hiroaki Onodera and colleagues publish code and datasets for a Japanese data-centre siting study. Zenodo lists three public archives, LocationAssessment, DataCenterSimulation and ReGRID, under Apache 2.0. The cited Cell Reports Sustainability paper examines trade-offs between decarbonisation and digitalisation through alternative data-centre locations. The release can support a modeller comparing electricity-system and site-location assumptions for future digital demand. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these coupled Japan study materials. Coverage is Japan and the model inputs used by the article, not a global siting recommendation. A limitation is that the public page refers users to README files inside each archive, not listing the full schema, scenario years or solver dependencies, so transfer requires closer documentation review. The archives were not downloaded and no grid or carbon result was independently reproduced. The three packages were treated as one study workflow, not three unrelated resources.
